import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
barplot = sns.barplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=df, ci='sd', capsize=0.2)
sns.scatterplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=df, color='black', alpha=0.7, s=80)
barplot.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Type', fontsize=16)
barplot.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=14)
barplot.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
